replacements.old: Avg Rank averages per-task percentiles within four equally weighted families against 11 fixed published baseline models.
replacements.new: Avg Rank uses the dashboard's average one-based percentile ranks against the fixed 11-model baseline reference, with each of 20 tasks weighted 5%: Conservation 15%, Motifs 40%, Core/non-core 40% and SV impact 5%.

replacements.old: _Top: AUROC, accuracy and average precision ×100; Avg Rank is a percentile. Higher is better._
replacements.new:
_Top: AUROC, accuracy and average precision ×100; Avg Rank is a percentile. Higher is better._

Avg Rank uses the leaderboard’s baseline scores and percentile calculation:[^rank-baselines] each of 20 tasks contributes 5%—Conservation 15%, Motifs 40%, Core/non-core 40% and SV impact 5%; AF is excluded.[^rank-weighting]

replacements.old: - **Avg Rank** remains unchanged for the zero-shot baseline comparison: rank each task against the same **11 published baseline models**, frozen at the [archived leaderboard revision](https://huggingface.co/spaces/plantcad/plantcad2-zeroshot-leaderboard/blob/f3c4ddb1978b78ca56fed5d40378f0aa5f19ec29/data/results.csv), then average task percentiles within families and give conservation, motifs, core/non-core and SV 25% each. Per-task percentile is `100 × (reference scores below the model + half the ties) / reference count`, using exact stored values. AF is unavailable for these baselines and is excluded.
replacements.new: - **Avg Rank** equally averages the 20 zero-shot task percentiles (5% each), using the dashboard’s average one-based ranks against the fixed 11-model baseline reference.[^rank-baselines][^rank-weighting] AF is excluded.

append:
[^rank-baselines]: [Leaderboard baseline scores](https://huggingface.co/spaces/plantcad/plantcad2-zeroshot-leaderboard/blob/f3c4ddb1978b78ca56fed5d40378f0aa5f19ec29/data/results.csv) and [task definitions](https://huggingface.co/spaces/plantcad/plantcad2-zeroshot-leaderboard/blob/f3c4ddb1978b78ca56fed5d40378f0aa5f19ec29/data/tasks.csv), frozen at `f3c4ddb`: 11 models, 220 scores.
[^rank-weighting]: Dashboard [percentiles](https://huggingface.co/spaces/plantcad/plantcad2-zeroshot-leaderboard/blob/f3c4ddb1978b78ca56fed5d40378f0aa5f19ec29/app.py#L42) and [equal-task mean](https://huggingface.co/spaces/plantcad/plantcad2-zeroshot-leaderboard/blob/f3c4ddb1978b78ca56fed5d40378f0aa5f19ec29/app.py#L137). All 11 baseline averages match the unfiltered dashboard. Marin models use [rank percentiles](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.percentileofscore.html) against that fixed reference without changing baseline ranks.
